channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Possible playbook for managing dwindling Colorado River supply includes cuts in California
item.description: Five proposals range from taking “no action” to a scenario that might result in water cuts to California and other states.

item.title: Builders Club steps up for the San Diego Food Bank
item.description: This year’s food drive was extremely successful, bringing in 711 pounds of food to provide 593 meals to those who are in need of food.

item.title: SDFC extends contract of ‘El Paletero,’ MVP finalist Anders Dreyer
item.description: "Extending Anders’ contract was a clear priority for us heading into this season,” said sporting director Tyler Heaps of Dreyer.

item.title: Volunteers needed for annual homeless Point-in-Time count
item.description: The annual Point-in-Time Count, from 4-8 a.m. Jan. 29, is coordinated by San Diego's Regional Task Force on Homelessness.

item.title: Federal judges uphold new California congressional districts
item.description: Voters overwhelmingly approved the new congressional maps, which were drawn in response to Republican redistricting efforts in Texas.

item.title: Pinback, George Clinton, fifth-generation mariachis, and a farewell show: Top concerts this week
item.description: From horn-driven fun to a Carpenters tribute, as well as George Clinton, local indie darlings Pinback, and much more.

item.title: Supreme Court opens path for challenges to voting laws. What that means for Rep. Issa’s mail-in ballot case
item.description: Wednesday’s Supreme Court decision has effectively made it easier for elected officials to sue over voting laws with which they disagree.

item.title: Video captures tense gunfire between police, felon in Balboa Park
item.description: Authorities have released body-cam footage of a police shooting that wounded a felon last month after he allegedly fired a pistol at a pursuing officer during a foot chase in Balboa Park.

item.title: Video of Southcrest arrest prompts SDPD use-of-force investigation
item.description: Forceful actions taken by San Diego Police Department officers while detaining a domestic violence suspect in Southcrest last weekend -- including a flurry of punches to the man's head -- are under "priority" internal investigation, the SDPD confirmed Wednesday.

item.title: Crew-11 to splash down near San Diego early Thursday after medical evacuation
item.description: The four-person crew from NASA's SpaceX Crew-11 mission to the International Space Station are set to splash down off the coast of San Diego County early Thursday.
